about.summary: Safety 4.0 Academy offers the world's first IOSH-approved and CPD-accredited certification program teaching workplace safety professionals how to leverage AI, IoT, SafetyTech, and digital technologies to transform safety management. Available as self-paced eLearning, a live Accelerator Cohort, or tailored In-Company training for entire EHS teams. Trusted by Siemens, LEGO, MARSH, and safety teams across 12 countries.
